payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet

condition.question: Is a frog visibly placed on the toilet lid in the edited image?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: determine whether a frog has been added on the toilet lid. A frog on the lid is evidence of partial progress toward putting a frog in the toilet, but is not placement inside the bowl and does not replace the required bowl placement. Do not count frogs on the tank or floor for this check.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the toilet lid is raised and has no visible frog. EDITED: a frog is visibly on the raised lid; a separate frog is inside the bowl, and other frogs are on the tank and floor.
condition.source_quote: Put a frog in the toilet
condition.aspect: A frog is placed on the toilet lid, a location distinct from the bowl.
condition.endpoint: A frog is visibly placed on the toilet lid.
condition.necessity: This is an auxiliary evidence check for concrete partial progress toward the request; it does not add a required endpoint or alter the bowl-placement requirement.
condition.zero_when: No frog is visibly added on the toilet lid; frogs only inside the bowl, on the tank, or on the floor do not satisfy this check.
condition.half_when: A frog is partly on the lid, with concrete evidence of lid placement but a substantial part of that placement not achieved.
condition.full_when: A frog is clearly placed on the toilet lid.

requirement.text: Put a frog in the toilet
requirement.source_phrase: Put a frog in the toilet
